mapper.select: SELECT c.nr_interno_conta AS "internoConta", c.nr_atendimento AS "numeroAtendimento", c.dt_periodo_inicial AS "dataInicio", c.dt_periodo_final AS "dataFim", c.ie_status_acerto AS "status" FROM tasy.conta_paciente c WHERE c.nr_atendimento = #{numeroAtendimento} AND c.ie_status_acerto = 1 ORDER BY c.dt_periodo_inicial
SELECT p.cd_pacote AS "codigo", p.ds_pacote AS "descricao" FROM tasy.pacote_exame p WHERE p.ie_situacao = 'A'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasy.auditoria_conta (nr_sequencia, nr_interno_conta, ds_observacao) VALUES (tasy.auditoria_conta_seq.NEXTVAL, #{internoConta}, #{observacao})
